priority_rules.priority_1: A sensor result above the contaminant limit with an independent same-site sample collected within 24 hours that also exceeds the limit requires immediate rapid sampling and public-health review.
priority_rules.priority_2: An uncorroborated exceedance, contradictory sample, or overdue calibration requires prompt confirmation based on the combined records.
priority_rules.priority_3: A reading contradicted by a compliant independent sample and explained by a documented maintenance or turbidity event may receive routine follow-up.

evidence_rules: Compare exact station, contaminant, units, timestamps, and record identifiers.
Read the current calibration and maintenance records before assigning a priority.
Treat vendor and site class as descriptive fields, not proof that a current reading is true or false.
Verify every search hit by its _id and _source because search may return coarse matches.
